WHO IT’S FOR

Commercial managers, branch directors, account leads and operations managers preparing account reviews and handover briefs.

STATUS & WHAT YOU CAN REVIEW

Working pilot: view hiring signals awaiting human review in the Research Workbench, open the saved source evidence, and pick up an unresolved finding in a later session alongside approved-source commercial briefs.
Problems we solve

Where work slows down

  • Hiring signals and account research lose context when a reviewer has to pause mid-session.
  • Teams need direct access to saved source evidence before approving any outreach or brief.
  • Unconstrained AI tools act without human sign-off on sensitive commercial findings.
What we offer

What your team receives

  • Research Workbench displaying hiring signals awaiting human review with saved source evidence.
  • Persistent session state so staff can pick up an unresolved finding in a later session.
  • Approved-source brief preparation with explicit revision control and human sign-off.

CAPABILITIES & WORKFLOWS

What AI Team & Power Command Centre
lets your team do.

Turns approved company documents into verifiable commercial briefs under explicit human revision and final sign-off.

01

Scoped assignment & approved sources

Assign a clear brief objective paired strictly with approved internal notes, account history or policy files.

02

Source-cited verification

Every point in the draft points back to an approved source passage you supplied — avoiding speculation and making factual checks fast.

03

Revisions & explicit human sign-off

Request changes round by round, compare versions and confirm human sign-off before any brief leaves the workspace.

04

Delivery brief preparation

Prepare reviewed delivery-brief instructions ready for Verified Handovers into Business Delivery.

verified scope.

EXAMPLE TO SHOW

SECTOR WORKFLOW DETAIL

Manager account-review briefing: ahead of a quarterly trade review, a branch manager uploads approved account notes, recent quote history and order summaries. The AI Team prepares a source-cited brief citing the exact supplied passages; the manager requests one revision tightening margin context, reviews the update, and records final sign-off.
